message.content:
Let \(u = \sin(x)\). Then \(du = \cos(x) \, dx\).

\[
\int -2 \cdot \sin(x) \cdot \cos(x) \, dx
= \int -2 \cdot u \, du
= -u^{2} + C
\]

Substitute back \(u = \sin(x)\):

\[
-\sin(x)^{2} + C
\]

<answer>-sin(x)**2 + C</answer>
